The school garden is one of the best places in the city. Ben hopes to visit London one day. Ben bought a dress at the shop yesterday. We have a maths quiz tomorrow.
Ben thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Lily is interested in reading. The weather was snowy that day. In fact, her piano performance was truly impressive for her age.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the school garden by bike. Ben learned a lot about science. Ben likes snowy days best. An exchange student joined our lab bench.
Life is full of small surprises. Ben and Lily had great fun there. Ben borrowed a book about science from the gym.
